title: Imp Jar Pink Lemonade 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pink Lemonade from Imp Jar is a vibrant twist on classic Lemonade. The tangy, refreshing Lemonade flavour is enhanced with a sweet, fruity infusion, making this blend an absolute delight for the senses, perfect for those who enjoy a fruity touch to their vape. Shortfill bottles from Imp Jar E-liquids offer the ideal way to experience some of the most popular flavours found in disposable vapes, while letting you personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 10ml of space for one nicotine shot, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 1 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Furthermore, Imp Jar’s unique 50PG/50PG ratio offers a more versatile blend which means you can use the e-liquid with a more diverse range of vape kits and coils of different resistances, so you’re not confined to sub-ohm vaping alone. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to Imp Jar shortfills' 50/50 ratio, they can be paired with a variety of vape kits, from high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils to MTL vape kits with high-resistance coils., ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquid flavours with long-lasting Shortfill bottles.. Imp Jar e-liquids replicate a wide array of delicious flavours made popular across numerous disposable vape devices, ranging from fruity delights, icy chills, sugary candies, to refreshing beverages.
